hypothesis: Before touching code for any reviewer comment, classify it into exactly one class and take only that class's action: (A) contract defect - the code contradicts its own documented contract: fix in code, ship the reviewer's reproducer plus one accept-side case at the exact boundary so the fix cannot score by over-rejecting; (B) unenforced promise - skill or plan text names a control no code path executes: wire the guard at the measurement entry point in the same commit, or label the line as an unenforced open gap; (C) unsettled design - the check depends on a pinning or authority decision not yet made: record an open gap with the exact accepted-but-should-be-rejected inputs and mark the text aspirational, do not implement. A comment is closed only when the artifact it names changed to match its class, and never by a doc edit the code contradicts.
